setup: Fresh >=5 or >=6 upper-BB breaches at exact 15m OPEN; freeze breached band prices.

reversal_triggers.RED_AFTER_EXTENSION: After extension threshold has occurred, first completed 15m candle with close < open.
reversal_triggers.BREAK_PREV_LOW_AFTER_EXTENSION: After extension, first completed 15m close < previous 15m low.
reversal_triggers.FAIL_SETUP_OPEN: After extension, first completed 15m close < original setup OPEN.

target_consumption_guard: Exclude target variant if frozen target touched before entry.
selection_rule: Fast conservative screen first; only a family positive in both pre-2025 and 2025+ gets canonical 1m replay.
